kebab_example: aliyun polardbx query-columnar-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000 --sql SELECT_0_FROM_polardbx_sls.sql_audit_log_LIMIT_100 --max-result-rows 1000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryColumnarLog

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the request. The value must match the region where the SQLQuery service is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 请求地域 ID，必须与当前 SQLQuery 服务部署地域一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB-X instance for which you want to query column store audit logs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询列存审计日志的 PolarDB-X 实例 ID
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The read-only query statement to execute. Only a single MySQL SELECT statement is supported. Query tables must use the fully qualified form polardbx_sls.<table_name>, and only the following tables are allowed: polardbx_sls.polardbx_log (kernel logs), polardbx_sls.slow_detail_log (slow query logs), polardbx_sls.slow_trans_log (slow transaction logs), and polardbx_sls.sql_audit_log (audit logs). Multi-statement queries, write operations, locks, user variables, dynamic placeholders, and reserved hints are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 要执行的只读查询语句。仅支持单条 MySQL SELECT；查询表必须使用 polardbx_sls.<表名> 全限定形式，并且仅限 polardbx_sls.polardbx_log（内核日志）、polardbx_sls.slow_detail_log（慢日志）、polardbx_sls.slow_trans_log（慢事务日志）和 polardbx_sls.sql_audit_log（审计日志）。不支持多语句、写操作、锁、用户变量、动态占位符或保留 Hint
parameters.name: sql

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of result rows to return for this request. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100. The actual number of returned rows is also subject to the top-level LIMIT clause in the SQL statement and the current service policy
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求最多返回的结果行数。取值范围为 1～1000；未传时默认返回不超过 100 行。最终行数还受 SQL 顶层 LIMIT 和当前服务策略约束
parameters.name: max_result_rows

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authentication principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The owner ID of the authentication principal

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The type of the authentication principal

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the missing permission

AppliedOffset.description_en: The top-level SQL LIMIT offset that the service actually applied. The value is 0 if the SQL statement does not specify an offset
AppliedOffset.description_zh: 服务实际应用的顶层 SQL LIMIT 偏移量；SQL 未指定偏移量时为 0

AppliedRowLimit.description_en: The maximum number of rows that the service actually returns after evaluating the top-level SQL LIMIT clause, MaxResultRows, the default value of the synchronous API, and the current service policy. This value does not include the extra row used to detect HasMore
AppliedRowLimit.description_zh: 服务综合 SQL 顶层 LIMIT、MaxResultRows、同步接口缺省值和当前服务策略后实际应用的最大返回行数，不包含用于探测 HasMore 的额外一行

HasMore.description_en: Indicates whether the service or API row limit truncated the SQL statement submitted by the caller. The value is false when the SQL statement with a smaller LIMIT clause is fully executed, which does not indicate that no more data exists in the underlying table
HasMore.description_zh: 表示服务或 API 行数边界是否截断了调用方提交的 SQL；SQL 自身较小的 LIMIT 完整执行时为 false，不代表底层表中没有更多数据

QueryElapsedTimeMilliseconds.description_en: The elapsed time from the start of the JDBC statement execution to the completion of reading the last result row or probe row. Unit: milliseconds
QueryElapsedTimeMilliseconds.description_zh: 从 JDBC 语句开始执行到读取完最后一条返回行或探测行的耗时，单位为毫秒

QueryId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by the service for this JDBC query
QueryId.description_zh: 服务为本次 JDBC 查询生成的唯一标识

Records.description_en: The list of query results. Each row is a JSON key-value object that maps column names to text values. All scalars are returned as strings. SQL NULL is encoded as the string null, and empty strings remain as empty strings
Records.description_zh: 查询结果列表。每行是列名到文本值的 JSON 键值对象；所有标量均以字符串返回，SQL NULL 固定编码为字符串 null，空字符串保持为空字符串

additionalProperties.description_en: A single column value in the query result. All scalars are returned as strings. SQL NULL is encoded as the string null. An empty string remains an empty string
additionalProperties.description_zh: 查询结果中的单个列值。所有标量均以字符串返回；SQL NULL 固定编码为字符串 null，空字符串保持为空字符串

RecordsSizeBytes.description_en: The total number of UTF-8 bytes of the JSON objects across all returned rows, excluding the array and fixed response fields. The complete JSON response of the synchronous API is also subject to a 16 MiB upper limit
RecordsSizeBytes.description_zh: 所有返回行的 JSON 对象 UTF-8 字节数之和，不包含数组和固定响应字段。同步完整 JSON 响应还受 16 MiB 上限约束

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID is used throughout the entire process from access, authentication, and routing to query completion, which facilitates end-to-end troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。同一请求从接入、鉴权、路由到查询完成均使用该 ID，便于全链路排查

ReturnedRowCount.description_en: The actual number of result rows returned in this synchronous response
ReturnedRowCount.description_zh: 本次同步响应实际返回的结果行数
